name: Sicklasjön to Baggensfjärden
estimatedTime: Half day one-way; full day if returning
description: Naturkartan canoe route linking Sicklasjön and Baggensfjärden via Järlasjön, Kolbottensjön, a portage, Duvnäsviken, Lännerstasundet and Baggensstäket.

waypoints.name: Järlasjön
waypoints.notes: Waterskiing may occur in upper Järlasjön.

publicTransport: Sickla public transport at western end; Saltsjö-Duvnäs/Lännersta options for eastern sections

safety.exposure: Mostly inland/sheltered water, with traffic and narrow-channel risks toward Baggensstäket.
navigationNotes: Keep clear of buoyed waterski course during practice.

protectionRules.summary: Near-city lake/canal route; check municipal reserve/shore rules around Sickla/Nacka and use legal portage/landing points.

generalRules.rule: Do not disturb or damage nature; avoid private zones and sensitive bird/wildlife areas.
Nature reserves, national parks, bird/säl protection areas and municipal reserves can restrict camping, fires, dogs, landing and anchoring.
Always check current Stockholm County fire bans before using any stove, grill or open fire.

rules: Use only legal public launches/landings; avoid private docks, club areas and signed restricted land.

needsFollowup: Verify exact current protection boundaries against Naturvårdsverket Skyddad natur map before public navigation/import.

caveats: Route geometries are approximate waypoint corridors, not GPX tracks and not navigational advice.
